title: Larp CLI JSON v1 (prospective; import OUT OF SCOPE)
description: Exactly one envelope per invocation. Local metadata only; never native provider output. See cli-v1.md.

id.description: Canonical decimal u64, at most 18446744073709551615; never reused. String prevents Swift/JS precision loss.

name.description: Windows reserved device names and larp are additionally refused.

usage.description: Stage 11 widening: the selected profile's LOCAL usage row from the same reader as `usage PROFILE --local`, or null. Never LIVE.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC, whole seconds, Z suffix. Stage 11 usage envelopes only.

percent.description: Percent 0-100, at most one decimal place (semantic check).

usage_reason.description: Why a window value is null. See docs/stages/11-usage.md.

pace.description: Derived at T=captured_at with E=clamp((W-(R-T))/W,0,1); see 11-usage.md pace rules.

usage_window.description: reason is null exactly when used_percent and resets_at are both non-null; captured_at is this window's own observation time (non-null exactly when used_percent is) and is the pace T.

usage_extra_label.description: Fixed labels or a sanitized LIVE Claude model display name followed by weekly. Raw bucket identifiers are omitted.

usage_extra_window.description: pace is null when window_seconds is null.

reset_credits.description: Tri-state, never absent: available=count>=1, none=count 0, not_recorded/unsupported=count null.

plan_label.description: User-entered display label, or a client-recorded plan value; never read from tokens or credential files.

plan.description: user = the user-entered plan_label (always wins); client_local = plan_type from the LOCAL Codex rollout record (D29); live_endpoint = planType from the Codex official-client LIVE snapshot (existing wire spelling). Provider plans are never stored; never from tokens or credential files.

usage_profile.description: One profile row of `usage`. No tokens, account IDs, emails, spend, cost or token counts.

usage_settings_profile.description: claude_statusline is the opt-in capture switch for Claude profiles; null for Codex.

evidence.description: Stage 08 bound-executable evidence. Read-only; nothing executed; no profile or account data.
